# Character Multiselect
Characters now can be individually enabled and disabled, job preferences are decoupled from the character. When you are assigned a job, a character will be selected out of the characters that have that job enabled, weighted by those characters preferences.
If no character has your job enabled, the first enabled character will be used (re-arrange by dragging characters in the editor). This also applies to latejoining.
Job preferences are editing in the lobby by clicking "Allow dragging" and then dragging to rearrange the jobs by priority.
